# Growloop

> Growloop is a growth app for solo founders that finds why your product isn't growing, helps you fix it, and measures what happens next.

Growloop is in invite-only beta and is free while in beta. It never posts, sends or publishes anything for you — you always approve and post yourself. Numbers on screen are labeled measured, estimated, benchmark or sample, and AI-written content is labeled.

## Live today

- Conversion leak finder: measured funnels that show where visitors drop off.
- Page audit by address: AI-written findings and rewrites for a page on your own site.
- Technical audit: eight rule-based checks that Google and AI assistants can find, read and understand your site.
- AI search visibility: how often ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude recommend your product, from repeated sample runs.
- Website tracking: one script line for real visits, signups and waitlist joins; no cookies or personal data.
- Product profile: an editable audience, competitor and buyer-question profile.

## Coming next

- Google search growth, listing optimization, finding conversations, results attribution, competitor gaps and experiments are not available yet.
